label: PUBLISHED pp -> pbar X invariant cross-section parametrizations of di Mauro, Donato, Goudelis and Serpico, Phys. Rev. D 90 (2014) 085017, arXiv:1408.0288v3: closed forms Eqs. (11), (12), (13) with the inelastic cross section of Eqs. (B1)-(B2); parameter values transcribed from Tables III, IV, V and VII (printed tables, read 2026-10-15). Used only by scripts/published_benchmark.py for the external benchmark; not a nominal set of predict.py.
units: E d3sigma/dp3 in mb GeV^-2 c^3 (sigma_in in mb, C_i of the bracket in GeV^-2, p_T in GeV); s in GeV^2

kinematics.x_R: E*_pbar / E*_pbar,max with E*_pbar,max = (s - 8 m_p^2) / (2 sqrt(s)) (Eqs. (4), (A13))
kinematics.lab_angle: cos(theta_max) = [E_pbar (E_p + m_p) - m_p (E_p - 3 m_p)] / [p_pbar p_p] (Eq. (A15)); E*_pbar = gamma_CM (E_pbar - v_CM p_pbar cos(theta)) (Eqs. (A3)-(A4))
kinematics.dsigma_dE: dsigma/dE_pbar = 2 pi p_pbar int_{cos(theta_max)}^{1} E d3sigma/dp3 d(cos theta) (Eq. (2))

sigma_in.equation: sigma_in = sigma_tot - sigma_el (Eq. (B1)); each = Z + B log^2(s/s_M) + Y1 (s_M/s)^eta1 - Y2 (s_M/s)^eta2 with B = pi (hbar c)^2 / M^2, s_M = (2 m_p + M)^2 (Eq. (B2)); GeV and mb

eq11.equation: sigma_in (1 - x_R)^C1 exp(-C2 x_R) [C3 exp(-C4 p_T) + C5 exp(-C6 p_T^2)]

eq12.equation: sigma_in (1 - x_R)^C1 exp(-C2 x_R) [C3 sqrt(s)^C4 exp(-C5 p_T) + C6 sqrt(s)^C7 exp(-C8 p_T^2)]
eq12.fit: all data sets of Table I

eq13.equation: sigma_in (1 - x_R)^C1 exp(-C2 x_R) |C3 sqrt(s)^C4 exp(-C5 p_T) + C6 sqrt(s)^C7 exp(-C8 p_T^2) + C9 sqrt(s)^C10 exp(-C11 p_T^3)|
eq13.fit: all data sets of Table I

not_included: the spline interpolation, the Tan & Ng and the Duperray et al. evaluations of Table VI (no closed form with parameters in this paper for the first two; for Duperray et al. the paper does not say whether Table VI uses its Table II refit or the original parameters with D1 and D2 exchanged); antineutrons, hyperons, helium channels
